limitations_and_notes.total_token_usage: Token counts were not logged in results/eval_results.jsonl during evaluation execution.
limitations_and_notes.relevance: LLM judge score (0.0 to 1.0) evaluating whether the generated answer directly addresses the user question.
limitations_and_notes.end_to_end_correctness: LLM judge score (0.0 to 1.0) evaluating semantic consistency and factual correctness against the expected ground truth answer.
limitations_and_notes.faithfulness: LLM judge score (0.0 to 1.0) evaluating whether all factual claims in the synthesized answer are supported by corpus evidence without hallucination.
limitations_and_notes.retrieval_quality: Computed as average recall of expected chunk IDs in the retrieved top-k chunks.
limitations_and_notes.citation_precision: Computed as the ratio of cited chunk IDs that match expected ground-truth chunk IDs.
limitations_and_notes.citation_recall: Computed as the fraction of expected ground-truth chunk IDs that are explicitly cited in the synthesized answer.
